record_title: Cyclotomic Hensel roots form an exact 2-adic prime-support isometry
scientific_context: A 2-adic extension of the recent cyclotomic least-prime extractor: unique even Hensel roots of Phi_n(X)+1 for squarefree indices encode the entire prime support through exact pairwise 2-adic distances.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The theorem is specific to the 2-adic equation Phi_n(X)=-1 and does not assert an odd-prime analogue or an efficient factorization algorithm. The motivating preprint is very recent, so contemporaneous unindexed work remains a residual originality risk. No independent validation or formal proof-assistant verification is asserted.

artifact_inventory.description: Exact modular Hensel-lifting checks of the root isometry, even-base valuation formula, and residue counts.
